challenges: Why not census console_release_probe itself (the DB the image actually migrated)? canonical-enforce.sh DROPs its target probe db first — pointing it there would destroy the boot target; re-spelling the census inline in YAML would be a third spelling of the mechanism. Checkout migrations at the admitted SHA are the same set the image embeds, so the census subject is equivalent; residual noted in followUps[2].

Why after-migrate rather than after-boot (which would also prove coexistence with a live app)? The reconcile pg_terminate_backend()s console_rt/*_cmd sessions cluster-wide — running it while the app serves kills live connections and flakes /readyz. Before boot is equally enforcing and strictly safer.

Chesterton: why did the workflow reconcile pre-migration at all? The image cannot migrate until roles/URLs exist — provision must precede migrate. Kept; the fix adds the post-migration half instead of moving the reconcile.
